comparison.objective: Diagnose and replace a faulty tactile cartridge.
comparison.physical_skill: Diagnosis followed by cartridge extraction, alignment, and insertion, rather than notch fracture and loose-tang recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Faulty cartridge replaced; diagnostic evidence, seating tolerance, and damage rubric are absent; body only reports demo scores.
comparison.reason: It tests fault diagnosis and replaceable-module exchange, not impact-driven removal of sacrificial tangs.
